$schema: Each rule: { match: substring(s) to match against the arrakis/yenta error string, class: A|B|C|D, fix: plain-English explanation for the user, auto_retry?: { action, ms? }, field?: which DraftAnswers field this maps to (for class A). Classes: A=missing-field (auto-recoverable with one ask+retry), B=structural (cannot self-heal — surface resolution), C=warning (200 with warnings[]), D=transient (one auto-retry).

rules.match: ownerAgent's office can't be empty
rules.fix: Owner agent missing office. Auto-recover: re-read profile via pre_flight, update_draft_section section=owner with officeId, retry.

rules.match: Sale price must be greater than 0
rules.fix: Sale price was zero or negative. Ask user, update_draft_section section=price-date, retry.

rules.match: ownerAgent info can't be empty
rules.fix: Draft has no owner agent. Set via update_draft_section section=owner before submit.

rules.match: ownerAgent's id is missing
rules.fix: Owner set without yentaId. Re-fire update_draft_section section=owner with the user's yentaId.

rules.match: For transactions, you must specify a list of buyers
rules.fix: Add at least one buyer (company or first+last) via update_draft_section section=buyer-seller.

rules.match: Address is required to update owner agent
rules.fix: Set the property address via update_draft_section section=location before owner.

rules.match: Agent already exists on referral
rules.fix: A referral is already attached. Remove via remove_participant before adding a new one.

rules.match: MISSING_DUAL_REPRESENTATION_COMMISSION
rules.fix: DUAL rep requires ≥1 agent with positive commission on BOTH sides. Recompute via compute_commission_splits + set_commission_splits(verify:true).

rules.match: DUAL_REPRESENTATION_SPLIT_TO_COMMISSION_CHECK
rules.fix: Per-side commission totals exceed available. Lower amounts so each side is ≤ that side's commission (0.10 tolerance).

rules.match: ONE_REF_AGENT_ERROR
rules.fix: arrakis allows only one non-opcity referral per draft. Remove the existing referral before adding another.

rules.match: Sale Commission is necessary for Dual Representation
rules.fix: Set saleCommission via update_draft_section section=price-date — required for DUAL.

rules.match: Listing Commission is necessary for Dual Representation
rules.fix: Set listingCommission via update_draft_section section=price-date — required for DUAL.

rules.match: Year built is required in the USA
rules.fix: yearBuilt is required for US properties. Ask the user, update_draft_section section=location, retry.

rules.match: You cannot create a transaction in a country where your account is not registered
rules.fix: Property is in a different country than your agent profile. Pick a property in your country, or have Real enable cross-country rights.

rules.match: Referral-only agents can only create referral transactions
rules.fix: Signed-in agent is referral-only — can only own REFERRAL / INTERNAL_REFERRAL drafts. Start over with dealType=REFERRAL.

rules.match: Referral-only agents cannot own regular transactions or listings
rules.fix: Referral-only agents cannot own a non-referral draft. Switch ownership to a non-referral agent or convert the deal to a referral.

rules.match: Referral-only agents cannot be agent representatives
rules.fix: A referral-only agent was added as a co-agent on a non-referral deal. Remove that participant or convert the deal to a referral.

rules.match: zero commission deal with the current provided commissions
rules.fix: zeroCommissionDeal flag is inconsistent with commission values. Set both to zero+flag=true, OR positive+flag=false.

rules.match: sum of commission percentage should be 100
rules.fix: Splits don't sum to 100. Recompute via compute_commission_splits + set_commission_splits(verify:true), retry.

rules.match: sum of total commission splits should be equal to total commissions
rules.fix: Amount-based splits don't match total commissions. Recompute (integer-cents).

rules.match: participant was provided in the commission splits that is no longer a part of the transaction
rules.fix: Participant removed after splits were set. get_draft for live participant ids, then recompute + set_commission_splits(verify:true).

rules.match: You cannot assign a commission split to a domestic team member
rules.fix: Domestic team commissions route through the domestic lead. Remove the domestic member's split and assign to the lead.

rules.match: Participant role is required for commission payer info
rules.fix: Payer creation needs all 6 fields; skip wire_commission_payer if info is incomplete. NOTE: submit does NOT silently accept a null payer — it succeeds but parks the transaction in NEW with a CRITICAL 'Commission Payer information is missing' until the payer is added (Bolt or wire_commission_payer). Surface this as an expected post-submit step, not a failure.

rules.match: First name is required for commission payer info|Last name is required for commission payer info|Email is required for commission payer info|Phone number is required for commission payer info|Company name is required for commission payer info
rules.fix: All 6 payer fields required. Skip the payer call entirely if you only have a subset — user fills the rest in Bolt.

rules.match: Property slug is not available
rules.fix: propertySlug taken. Try another or omit (arrakis generates one).

rules.match: salePrice cannot be empty
rules.fix: Sale price missing. Ask user, update_draft_section section=price-date, retry.

rules.match: commissionSplitsInfo cannot be empty
rules.fix: No splits written. Run compute_commission_splits + set_commission_splits(verify:true).

rules.match: Commission document payer role must be one of
rules.fix: Payer role must be TITLE, SELLERS_LAWYER, or OTHER_AGENT. Adjust wire_commission_payer.

rules.match: Unauthorized
rules.fix: Session expired. Reopening browser to sign in.
Auth expired. Reopening browser to sign in.

rules.match: ECONNRESET
rules.fix: Network blip. Retrying once.

rules.match: 502 Bad Gateway
rules.fix: Server hiccup. Retrying once.

rules.match: 503 Service Unavailable
rules.fix: Briefly unavailable. Retrying once.

rules.match: No enum constant com.real.yenta.service.dto.search.ActiveAgentSearchRequest.AgentSearchSortBy.createdAt
rules.fix: MCP bug: search uses sortBy=createdAt but yenta no longer accepts that. Fix the sortBy value in src/services/YentaAgentApi.ts to a valid AgentSearchSortBy enum value.

rules.match: The parameter 'sortBy' of value 'createdAt' could not be converted to type 'List'
rules.fix: Same root cause as the AgentSearchSortBy.createdAt enum error — fix src/services/YentaAgentApi.ts to send a valid value.

rules.match: "status": 403, "body": ""
rules.fix: 403 with empty body = VPN to env is down OR session revoked by Real (admin bounce / long inactivity). Not 401. Check VPN + yenta reachability + ask Real admin.

rules.match: MCP error -32001: Request timed out
rules.fix: Tool call timed out at transport. For pre_flight, usually means the browser-login helper couldn't complete. Re-run or check the browser.

rules.match: The parameter 'id' of value 'myself' could not be converted to type 'UUID'
rules.fix: MCP bug: pre_flight calls /users/myself but yenta now requires a UUID. Fix src/auth/ to call /users/me.

rules.match: Agent not found by id
rules.fix: yentaId 404 in target env. Likely wrong env (yentaIds don't cross envs), typo, or deactivation. Double-check the env.

rules.match: Cannot initialize a CANDIDATE agent
rules.fix: yentaId belongs to a CANDIDATE agent. arrakis refuses CANDIDATE on transactions. Pick a different ACTIVE agent, or use kind=external referral.

rules.match: transaction-builder MCP tools aren't loaded
rules.fix: Session started before MCP registered. Exit (/exit or ⌘Q) and run claude again. If it persists, run ./scripts/smoke-mcp.sh.
